Class NativeLedMatrix

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.NativeLedMatrix
All Implemented Interfaces:
LedMatrix
public final class NativeLedMatrix extends Object implements LedMatrix
The board's LedMatrix: each method is an LED matrix intrinsic the compiler lowers to the Arduino_LED_Matrix library, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM. Mock LedMatrix instead.

    Declared here, not inherited, because Juno dispatches an interface call only to a method its class declares.
    void
    loadFrame(int word0, int word1, int word2, int word3)
    Loads a frame packed MSB-first into four 32-bit words, exactly as the underlying loadFrame(const uint32_t[...]) of the board's Arduino_LED_Matrix library expects: the UNO R4's 96 pixels use the first three words and ignore word3; the UNO Q's 104 pixels use all four, the last holding the final 8 pixels in its top bits.
    static void
    setLedMatrix(LedMatrix replacement)
    Makes ArduinoUno.getLedMatrix() hand out replacement: for a whole-program emulator or a unit test, never on the board.
